name: print-social-developer-meetup-flyer-grid-and-code-icons
title: Developer meetup flyer on mint grid paper with code and lock stickers
whatItIs: A mint-green square-ruled background with a white logo pill, a small 'Weekly Meetup' tag, giant two-line title 'Beyond Codes' with 'Codes' in blue, blue and green pills for Venue and Date & Time, and 3D-style stickers (code tag, lock, coloured chevrons) at the right edge.
whatItMeans: Friendly and techy; the notebook grid says 'learning' and the stickers add playfulness.
techniques: Use graph paper as the background to signal coding and notes.
Split the title into black and brand-blue words.
Attach 3D icons partly cropped at the edge.

vocabulary.definition: A ruled square pattern like a notebook.
Rounded labels for venue and date.
An icon cropped by the frame.
A headline with one word coloured.
